items.title: Financial Document Processing
items.description: New York's financial services sector generates enormous volumes of financial documents requiring structured extraction: credit memos, ISDA agreements, loan applications, insurance policies, regulatory filings, and securities documents. AI document intelligence extracts structured data from these variable-format documents at volume and accuracy rates that manual processing can't match. Loan origination document processing, KYC/AML document extraction, trade confirmation processing, regulatory filing ingestion, insurance application processing. Cost: $25,000–$80,000 | Timeline: 8–16 weeks.
items.label: Financial Documents

items.title: Compliance Communication Monitoring
items.description: FINRA-regulated firms, registered investment advisors, and banking institutions in New York face ongoing communication surveillance obligations. AI NLP systems scanning email, chat, and voice transcript archives for policy violations, suitability concerns, and suspicious patterns — reducing the manual review burden on compliance teams while improving coverage. Cost: $35,000–$90,000 | Timeline: 10–18 weeks.
items.label: Compliance Monitoring

items.title: Legal Document Automation
items.description: New York's dense legal market — BigLaw firms, corporate legal departments, LegalTech companies — processes enormous volumes of contracts, discovery documents, and regulatory submissions. AI automation extracting structured data from contracts, classifying discovery documents, and generating standardized document sections reduces the associate hours that routine document work requires. Cost: $30,000–$80,000 | Timeline: 10–18 weeks.
items.label: Legal Automation

items.title: Healthcare Prior Authorization Automation
items.description: New York health systems face a prior authorization burden that consumes significant clinical and administrative staff time. AI automation processing prior auth requests, matching clinical documentation to payer criteria, and routing exceptions to clinical reviewers delivers meaningful cost and turnaround time improvement. Cost: $35,000–$85,000 | Timeline: 10–18 weeks.
items.label: Healthcare Prior Auth

items.title: Enterprise Communication Triage
items.description: New York enterprises handling thousands of inbound emails, tickets, and inquiries per day benefit from AI classification and routing that directs each item to the right team without manual reading of every message. Reduces triage labor, improves response time for high-priority items, and scales with volume spikes. Cost: $20,000–$55,000 | Timeline: 8–14 weeks.
items.label: Communication Triage

items.title: We already have RPA — why do we need AI automation too?
items.description: Traditional RPA handles fixed-format, deterministic workflows. New York's financial and legal document environments are the opposite of fixed-format — AI automation handles the variable formats, natural language, and judgment-requiring extraction that RPA fails on. They're complementary, not competing.

sections.title: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.description: Common questions from New York organizations about AI automation with ClickMasters.

items.question: Can AI automation handle New York's legal and financial document volume at enterprise scale?
items.answer: Yes — ClickMasters builds async batch processing pipelines (Celery/Redis or AWS SQS) that handle thousands of documents per hour without blocking throughput.

items.question: Does AI automation require changes to our existing New York banking systems?
items.answer: ClickMasters designs automation as an API integration layer — connecting to existing systems via available APIs or file-based interfaces without requiring system replacement.

items.question: How does AI automation handle multilingual documents common in New York's international business environment?
items.answer: Language detection and multilingual processing via multilingual document AI models (Azure Document Intelligence multilingual, custom multilingual extraction models) is scoped during Discovery for New York clients with multilingual document populations.

items.question: Can ClickMasters automate Bloomberg or Refinitiv data processing for our New York financial firm?
items.answer: Yes — financial data feed processing, alerts automation, and document ingestion from financial data platforms are standard New York FinTech automation scope.

items.question: What straight-through processing rate can we achieve for New York financial document automation?
items.answer: 65–85% STP is typical for mature financial document automation deployments. ClickMasters sets expectations based on your specific document type mix rather than aspirational benchmarks.

items.question: How do we monitor whether New York AI automation is working over time?
items.answer: Through dashboards tracking STP rate, exception rate by document type, processing cycle time, and accuracy spot-checks — ClickMasters builds these metrics as standard, not as a separate engagement.
